# Townley Photography

> Professional photography and film across the Puget Sound region of Washington State, run by Spencer Townley. Ten years behind the camera, serving clients from individuals to Fortune 500 companies. FAA Part 107 licensed drone pilot. Service lines: portrait photography, real estate and drone photography, landscape and wildlife fine art, event videography, and marketing/brand video.

Service area: Seattle, Tacoma, Bellevue, Everett, Kitsap County, and surrounding Puget Sound communities. Travel beyond 30 miles adds a fee.
Standard photo delivery: 48 hours via private online gallery. Video projects: about one week.
Contact: hello@townleyphotography.com | https://townleyphotography.com/book/

## Services and pricing

- [Portrait photography](https://townleyphotography.com/portrait/): Families, seniors, couples, headshots, and milestone sessions. Mini $250 (30 min, 10 edited images), Signature $450 (60 min, 30 edited images), Full Experience $700 (2 hours, 60 edited images). All packages include a private gallery and print release.
- [Real estate photography](https://townleyphotography.com/real-estate/): MLS-ready listing photography with HDR, drone aerials, and 3D tours. Essential $200 (under 2,000 sqft, 25 photos), Standard $325 (2,000-3,500 sqft, 40 photos plus 10 drone aerials), Premium $500 (3,500+ sqft, 50+ photos plus Matterport 3D tour). Next-business-day delivery; same-day rush $75.
- [Landscape and wildlife fine art](https://townleyphotography.com/landscape-wildlife/): Open-edition prints $95, limited-edition signed prints $350 (edition of 50), commercial image licensing $300 per image for one year non-exclusive web and print use.
- [Event film and marketing video](https://townleyphotography.com/video/): Event highlight films, brand stories, and social cutdowns.
